The '''Royal Manse''' was a building located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]] that was home to the [[Doan Royal House]]. It was located directly above the [[Stone Prison]]. When the Stone [[Prison/Legends|Prison]] was destroyed by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] in [[980 BBY]], the tremors from the prison's collapse were felt in the Royal Manse, alerting the beings there that Serra had used the Stone Prison, an act which had been forbidden.
